gen-gf-unica-one-rubik: Rubik keeps its lowercase big and soft. Unica One above it is stark, every stroke the same thickness, so the pair looks like a sign over a friendly conversation.
gen-mystery-quest-roboto-slab: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest a nostalgic, storybook feel. Roboto Slab backs it with structured, precise lines, and that tidy grounding is what makes the pair work.
gen-flavors-poppins: Whimsical and stubby, Flavors stands tall with diagonals as heavy as its stems. Poppins follows with loose, rounded curves, and a generous heading size would let that sturdy look carry.
gen-gf-paprika-mulish: Paprika spreads its big lowercase across the line like capitals. Mulish sits beside it with gentle, uniform strokes and wide horseshoe openings, so the loud top feels softened by an approachable partner.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-inter: Tilt Neon draws a glowing tube-like stroke with a splayed c terminal and a large x-height. Inter smooths that out below.
gen-press-start-2p-roboto-slab: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P brings a playful, pixel-pinned look. Roboto Slab is the structured one, with a dense middle zone and open throats, so one does the shouting and the other the precise explaining.
gen-megrim-rubik: A hollow, glass-tube thinness with a skyward x-height defines Megrim. Rubik handles the actual reading, with big, soft lowercase that stays legible at small sizes.
gen-raleway-fs-literata: Precise and approachable, Raleway bends every letter from one wire-like line with breathing space inside each curve. Literata follows with bookish, slightly weightier round letters and wide mouths, a comfortable pace for paragraph after paragraph.
gen-righteous-bitter: Bitter has a very large lowercase and a see-through gap in each s, which makes it dependable and grounded. Righteous brings the fun, with bowls that fill the line.
gen-gf-autour-one-poppins: A clear channel leads into every round letter of Autour One. Poppins matches it with loose, sturdy curves and no thick-thin flicker, so the whole pair feels bold yet modern.
